Mapped all 20 nodes in **d3 (Renderer)**. The merge-ready JSON is at `/tmp/ghostty-d3.OwURDC8d/d3.json`. It includes 962 source ranges with scope and role records, covering both Metal and OpenGL through presentation to their runtime hosts.

- **d3/n11:** The locked block copies mouse state and uses it for OSC 8 links. Regex link handling later reads `state.mouse` again after unlocking.
- **d3/n19:** Embedded Metal supports synchronous main-thread drawing. GTK/OpenGL draws on the renderer thread and composites the exported frame on the main thread.

The checkout was unchanged. I checked node references, roles, file bounds, exclusions, and overlaps locally. `validate_source_mappings` was not available in this session.
